title: Embedding Layer
hint: Store a weight matrix of shape (num_embeddings, embedding_dim) as nn.Parameter. Forward = weight[indices].

description.text: Implement an embedding lookup table: map integer token indices to rows of a learnable weight matrix.

examples.output: Shape (3, 4): three rows taken from the weight table.
examples.explanation: Same index repeats the same embedding vector.

constraints: Forward selects rows by indices (any shape of indices supported like nn.Embedding).
